result:
I would make it impossible for people to believe they are an exception to the rules they think everyone else should follow.

If people couldn't rationalize away their own hypocrisy — if the mental gymnastics that let you demand kindness from others while being cruel yourself, or preach honesty while lying to yourself, just... stopped working — everything else would start to fix itself.
